intro: An all-new squad of beautiful girl soldiers rewrites history in this one-of-a-kind World War II universe! A brand-new engine delivers an epic evolution unlike anything you've played before!
description:
Stunning cel-shaded visuals bring an anime-style world to life, opening the gates to a battlefield that's entirely your own. Fight alongside a squad of girl soldiers on the front lines in a WWII FPS experience found nowhere else. Set against the backdrop of World War II, this story-driven single-player FPS lets you steal weapons from fallen enemies and charge straight through the chaos of war. Whether you're a military history enthusiast or a player who craves breathtaking visuals paired with a gripping narrative, this is the ultimate solo FPS made for you. Amid the gunfire and bonds forged on the battlefield, only one person can rise as the true hero, and that's you.

・Powered by a brand-new engine for smoother, more intense combat, every gunfight now feels more real and more exhilarating than ever
・Cutting-edge cartoon rendering combined with cel-shading technology delivers vivid, anime-inspired visuals, turning every battlefield moment into a work of art
・Includes wildly unexpected alternate world costumes that completely flip the main story's tone on its head. Switch into an entirely different vibe and it'll feel like you're playing a brand new game altogether, a fresh twist you won't see coming.
・A heartfelt story with a full ending sequence, follow a carefully crafted narrative all the way through to an emotional finale you won't forget
・Dialogue events and side quests woven throughout every mission, banter between squadmates and hidden quests deepen your connection to the story
・Steal weapons straight from defeated enemies, build your own unique combat style and unleash spectacular firefights with a huge arsenal at your disposal
・Historically grounded missions inspired by real events, cinematic cutscenes play after every stage clear, and a wide range of authentic WWII era weapons are ready to collect and use
・Immersive 3D audio paired with a 3D physics engine for realistic, high impact gameplay
・A wide range of 3D effects and battlefield graphics that capture the tension of total war
・Cooperative combat alongside AI controlled allied soldiers for deeper tactical play
・Cover based combat using environmental objects for intense, authentic firefight tension

Charge through iconic, historically inspired battles from World War II and take down every enemy in your path. Complete every episode and an unforgettable, emotional ending awaits you at the finish line. A brand new engine combined with cel-shaded visuals delivers an immersive experience like nothing you've played before. Download now and step into a war story that's entirely your own!

Prologue
After the end of World War I, Germany struggled to accept the reality of defeat. Rather than offering reconciliation, the Treaty of Versailles ensured the nation could never rise as a dominant power again. Crushing reparations led to excessive currency printing, triggering runaway hyperinflation that devastated the economy.

Rather than easing the people's suffering, the nation's leaders exploited nationalism to consolidate power. Radical nationalist sentiment spread rapidly as people, humiliated and impoverished, began yearning for a strong leader and a return to former glory. Amid this turbulent atmosphere, a charismatic young girl skillfully harnessed the anger and resentment of the masses, rapidly building her own power base.

Then in 1939, Nazi Germany's invasion of Poland ignited the flames of World War II. Amid the smoke and chaos of the battlefield, a squad of girl soldiers carrying the weight of destiny emerged. A story never told before, one where girl soldiers take center stage in a war unlike any other, is about to begin.
